apiKey.title: Stadia Maps API key
apiKey.description: Used only to validate the Valhalla/Stadia street-mode backend in the health check. A registered self-hosted Valhalla service is preferred; Stadia is the final fallback and needs a key. Transit reachability never uses this backend. The isochrone requests themselves use the apps/api VALHALLA_API_KEY env. Also settable via INTEGRATION_OVERLAY_TOOL_TRAVEL_TIME_APIKEY.

steps: Sign up at client.stadiamaps.com/signup (free, no credit card).
Open the dashboard and click 'Manage Properties'.
Select your property from the dropdown.
Under Authentication Configuration, generate your API key and copy it.
x-openmapx-setup.cost: Free tier: 200,000 credits/month, no credit card.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Same Stadia Maps account/key as routing-valhalla. Self-hosted Valhalla needs no key. Free tier is non-commercial / evaluation only.

dataSources.name: Valhalla-compatible street isochrones (Stadia fallback)
dataSources.notes: Endpoint resolution prefers the registered self-hosted Valhalla service, then VALHALLA_URL, and finally Stadia Maps. The Stadia fallback requires VALHALLA_API_KEY and its free tier is limited to non-commercial / evaluation use. This source is used only for street modes; transit reachability uses response-attributed MOTIS/Transitous data.
